title: C1 modern vector benchmark: B.7 plus exact moving-muon B.13 with Croon radial transport
status: C1 interior-profile transport calculation; outer semi-Compton opacity remains unavailable

model.neutrino_flavours: nu_mu with profile mu_numu(r), plus nu_tau with mu_numu_tau=0
model.muon_targets: both mu_minus and mu_plus, separately retained
model.dimuon_channel: closed for all Croon Fig. 2 masses because 200 MeV < 2*m_mu

transport.optical_depth: radial integral of reduced absorption Gamma_abs-Gamma_prod, mode by mode
transport.angular_escape_average: omitted to match Croon radial prescription
transport.lapse_redshift: omitted to match Croon Sec. 3 comparison
transport.outer_neutrino_opacity: B.7 two-flavour vacuum decay width per mode
transport.outer_semicompton_opacity: omitted; no validated 25--100 km muon susceptibility

numerics.energy_map: omega=m+Tmax*y^2, y in [0,6], Gauss-Legendre in y
numerics.radial_integrator: cumulative_simpson for optical depth; Simpson for luminosity

10.outer_opacity: B.7 two-flavour vacuum decay per mode from Rnu to Rfar=100 km; outer B.13 semi-Compton opacity is omitted because no validated 25--100 km muon-susceptibility profile is available

scope: The C1 calculation replaces Croon Eqs. (4.6)-(4.7) with the mode-resolved Blinov B.7 neutrino kernel and exact-recoil B.13 moving-muon Compton kernel. It keeps Croon's radial transport geometry. It is a public-profile reconstruction and does not include the unknown 25--100 km semi-Compton opacity.
